dirichlet_bc.description: Dirichlet ghost-cell prescription for cell-centered uniform Cartesian grids (ESS §9.2 / §9.4). The ghost cell u[-1] is set so that the linear interpolation to the boundary face gives the prescribed value: u_ghost = 2*u_bc - u[0]. Pattern matches the synthetic `bc` node (§9.2) with `$side` bound to the boundary side (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, …); ESS kind/side pattern matching wires this when available. `produces` declares the ghost variable per §9.4 (not yet processed by the current rule engine; documented for forward compatibility). Analytic check: (u_ghost + u[0]) / 2 = (2*u_bc - u[0] + u[0]) / 2 = u_bc. Note: no spacing ($h) is needed — the ghost value depends only on u[0] and the prescribed boundary value.
